newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Meredith Corp earnings cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Meredith Corp earnings cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said Tuesday it lowered its earnings estimate for Meredith Corp for fiscal 1997 to $1.19 from $2.38 and its estimate for 1998 to $1.23 from $2.46.

-- Gruntal said the move reflects Meredith's two-for-one stock split, a move Gruntal believes will likely enhance trading liquidity and make Meredith shares more affordable to a broader base of investors.
-- Gruntal said it also cut its price target to $30 from $60 a share.
-- Meredith publishes home and family oriented periodicals. Its shares closed up 5/8 Tuesday at 25-1/8.
